rationale: The AMLAS Version 1.1 guidance explicitly states it is a six-stage methodology for ML components (S-CHAL-004-R1). It links system safety requirements to data, learning, verification, and deployment evidence (S-CHAL-004-R1). The guidance also clearly limits its scope to the ML component, advises against using it in isolation, and states its primary focus is on offline supervised learning (S-CHAL-004-R2, S-CHAL-004-R3).
evidence_locators: PDF pp. 2–3, Introduction and Overview of AMLAS
